D001_m001.question:
"It's been a tough six months, doctor. I just feel… scattered. My husband keeps asking what's wrong, but I can't even put my finger on it. At work, I'm usually so on top of things, but lately, reports are piling up, and I can't seem to get my head around organizing my day. I'll be working on something, and then my mind just drifts off to some random thought, or I'll notice something out the window and lose my train of thought entirely.

It's not just the inattention either. I feel like I'm constantly moving, even when I'm sitting down. My legs are always tapping, or I’m fiddling with something. And the talking… I know I interrupt people, I just get so excited about what I want to say that it tumbles out before I can stop it. My colleagues have even started making jokes about it. It’s embarrassing, and frankly, I’m exhausted trying to keep up with myself. It feels like this has always been a part of me, but it's just gotten so much worse lately."

    C. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive Presentation)
    D. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)
